about: Ctrl All 0.2 for Digitakt OS 1.54: the author's released .elemod file, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: Ctrl All
mods.summary: Ten Digitakt MKI mods: new LFO waves with pictures, a looping random LFO, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real units, mute snapshots, track solo, velocity humanise and Euclidean accents.
mods.description: Ctrl All, after the Analog Rytm mod: hold TRK and press YES to turn CTRL ALL on or off (ALL shows in the top-right corner). While it is on, a parameter lock you set with a knob (hold a trig, turn a knob) is also set on the same step of every other track that has a trig there: the other audio tracks from an audio track, the other MIDI tracks from a MIDI track. Only knob turns are copied, never pastes, clears or CREATE RANDOM LOCKS.
mods.author: Cere, made with Claude
mods.on_unit: All ten tested together on a real Digitakt MKI (OS 1.54) with core and seq-events: LFO waves and pictures, Deja Vu loops and destinations, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real-unit displays, mute snapshots, track solo, humanise, Euclid accents and the MOD SETTINGS row. OS 1.53 not supported.
